paper.title_en: Complete quasinormal modes of Type-D black holes. II. Extremal Kerr black holes
paper.abstract_en: We develop a double-confluent Heun (HeunD) method that extends our construction of complete quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectra to extremal Kerr black holes. Matching the horizon-ingoing and infinity-outgoing radial solutions together with angular regularity yields the frequencies directly at extremality, without extrapolation from nonextremal spins. For gravitational perturbations, we obtain an expanded spectrum on both conventional and unconventional Riemann sheets, including additional QNMs revealed by analytic continuation across frequency branch cuts. Continuation in spin connects the extremal modes to our complete Schwarzschild spectrum, including its unconventional branches. We show for the first time that unconventional Class I sequences with $m<0$, continued from unconventional Schwarzschild modes, approach negative superradiant bounds with vanishing damping in the extremal limit. We also identify finite-damping modes interspersed among sequences approaching zero damping, showing that a single overtone cutoff cannot describe the transition to extremality. Independent scattering-amplitude calculations verify representative frequencies and their sheet assignments, while a contour count establishes spectral completeness within a bounded frequency domain. Uniform matching near the superradiant bound further distinguishes critical accumulation from isolated extremal QNMs and resolves the associated Riemann-sheet structure. These results bring extremal Kerr into our unified treatment of black-hole QNM spectra and reveal how the Schwarzschild mode families reorganize in the extremal limit.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文直接构造极端 Kerr 黑洞的完整准正规模谱，理论深度高，方法（HeunD 匹配、散射振幅验证、围道计数、均匀匹配）较系统，且给出极端极限下模式族重组的新的结论，符合本索引对引力和黑洞基础问题的关注。
decision.title_zh: Type-D 黑洞的完整准正规模。II. 极端 Kerr 黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一种双合流 Heun（HeunD）方法，将我们关于完整准正规模（QNM）谱的构造推广到极端 Kerr 黑洞。将视界入射和无穷远出射的径向解与角向正则性相匹配，可直接在极端性处得到频率，而无需从非极端自旋进行外推。对于引力扰动，我们在常规和非常规 Riemann 面上都得到了扩展的谱，包括通过跨频率分支割线解析延拓所揭示的附加 QNM。自旋方向的延拓将极端模式与我们完整的 Schwarzschild 谱（包括其非常规分支）联系起来。我们首次表明，从非常规 Schwarzschild 模式延拓而来的、具有 $m<0$ 的非常规 Class I 序列在极端极限下以趋于零的阻尼逼近负的超辐射界。我们还识别出散布在趋于零阻尼的序列之间的有限阻尼模式，表明单一的泛音截断无法描述向极端性的过渡。独立的散射振幅计算验证了代表性频率及其所在 Riemann 面的归属，而围道计数则在有界频率域内确立了谱的完备性。在超辐射界附近的均匀匹配进一步区分了临界累积与孤立的极端 QNM，并厘清了相关的 Riemann 面结构。这些结果将极端 Kerr 纳入我们对黑洞 QNM 谱的统一处理，并揭示了 Schwarzschild 模式族在极端极限下如何重组。
